bibl.title: The Regain of Ancient Greek Music and the Contribution of Papyrology.
bibl.seg: Egert Pöhlmann, The Regain of Ancient Greek Music and the Contribution of Papyrology.
Egert Pöhlmann, Ancient Music in Antiquity and Beyond. Collected Essays (2009-2019) = Beiträge zur Altertumskunde. 381 (Berlin - Boston, 2020) pp. 227-250.
bibl.note: Paper presented at the international meeting of the Centre de Documentation de Papyrologie Littéraire at Liège (26 March 2019) and at the 12th meeting of the MOISA (8-10 July 2019) in Thessaloniki. - 1. Introduction. - 2. The beginnings by Vincenzo's Dialogo. - 3. The ancient Greek notation according to Alypius. - 4. Fragments of Ancient Greek Music until 2018. - 5. New insights in the history of Greek poetry and music. - 6. The relation of melody and prosodia of the poetic text. - 7. Ancient Greek hymns with notation. - 8. Music of the stage of the 5th and 4th c. BC. - 9. Spoken verse of late classical tragic texts set to music in imperial times. - Conclusion. - Appendix 1: Paian, P. Berol. Inv. 6870 + 14097 (= MP3 1706.1; LDAB 4985); - Appendix 2: The Trinitiarian monody (P. Oxy. XV, 1797 [= MP3 93; LDAB 231]) with supplements (translation: Andrew Barker); - Appendix 3: Medea of the younger Carcinus, P. Paris Louvre Inv. E 10534 (= MP3 236.04; LDAB 10106).
